_comment: FICTIONAL test expectations for the Donna demo. These declare 'a change here needs a test there' rules that are about test *existence and relevance*, complementing ADR-0007's 'the test must change in the same commit' constraints.

expectations.reason: Contract shape changes need the contract test suite run, because it is the only place that asserts what clients can rely on.
The gate is the only thing standing between a malformed request and the engine, so changes to it or to the routes that declare it need the gate tests.
Batching and KV cache accounting changes need the scheduler tests, which cover admission order, the token budget and cache exhaustion.
Request lifecycle and admission control changes need the end-to-end engine test, which is the only test that exercises the full step loop.
ADR-0008 requires that a streaming request which stops making progress releases its capacity. No test asserts this yet, so a change to the streaming path has nothing to validate it against.
